observations: Photos show a large stacked pile of blue plastic barrels/drums, viewed from two angles.
Drums appear to be standard 200-litre style plastic barrels with narrow bung openings on top (closed-head drums).
Surfaces show visible wear: scratches, faded patches, dirt staining, and some rust-colored marks around the bung holes (possibly from metal rings or prior leakage).
Condition varies drum to drum - some look relatively clean, others are stained or discolored.
A watermark 'EMMALINK CONCEPT NIG' appears on photo 1, which is the seller's business name, not a product brand.
No visible cracks or major structural damage in the photos, but the view is distant/stacked so individual drum condition cannot be confirmed.
No capacity markings, brand, or manufacturer label is legible in either photo.

identity.kind: used plastic storage drum (bulk lot, bung-top barrel)

claims.claim: Can be used for storage of any kind of liquid
claims.evidence: Neither photo shows the drum's interior, seal condition, or confirms it is food-grade/chemical-grade; prior contents and liner integrity cannot be judged from stacked exterior shots.

risks.risk: Unknown prior contents (e.g. industrial chemical, oil) could contaminate drum for liquid storage, especially if buyer wants food/water use.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of interior and any residual labeling/manufacturer stamp inside the drum.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-food-grade/contaminated, general liquid storage only

risks.risk: Leaks, cracks, or damaged bung threads not visible in a distant stacked photo.
risks.proof: Close-up photo or short video of the specific drum being sold, including the bung cap and base seam.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed leak-free, i.e. as-is/for-repair condition

risks.risk: Actual drum selected may differ in condition from the best-looking ones in the pile (buyer doesn't choose which specific unit).
risks.proof: Photo/video of the exact unit(s) to be handed over at pickup.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lower end of condition seen (worn/stained units)

risks.risk: True capacity (litres) not stated or shown via markings.
risks.proof: Photo of embossed capacity marking on the drum body.
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard 200L generic drum, unconfirmed

proof_requests: Close-up photo of a single representative drum, including interior and bung cap.
Photo of any embossed capacity/manufacturer marking on the drum body.
Short video showing the drum being tipped/rotated to check for leaks or cracks.
Photo of the exact unit(s) that will be handed over at pickup.
response.reason: Item is clearly identifiable as a lot of used plastic storage drums (by type), so it can be priced at worst-case condition (unconfirmed food-grade status, unverified leak integrity) pending the listed proofs.
